messages.text: From forgettable EFL loans to Ballon d'Or winner - Kane's 'Cinderella story'

metadata.summary: From forgettable EFL loan spells to being crowned the best player in the world, it is no wonder Harry Kane’s former boss thinks of his Ballon d'Or win as a fairy tale.
metadata.content: Harry Kane wins Ballon d'Or: Bayern Munich striker completes 'Cinderella story' from EFL loans to world's best player | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Harry Kane wins Ballon d'Or: Bayern Munich striker completes 'Cinderella story' from EFL loans to world's best player Harry Kane wins 2026 Ballon d'Or to become first Englishman to land award in 25 years; Bayern Munich and England captain's Ballon d'Or victory called 'Cinderella story' by Tim Sherwood; ten days after lifting the Ballon d'Or, Kane has signed a new three-year deal with the German champions Declan Olley Football Journalist @declanolley Thursday 5 November 2026 08:42, UK From forgettable EFL loan spells to being crowned the best player in the world, it is no wonder Harry Kane’s former boss thinks of his Ballon d'Or win as a fairy tale. "This is a Cinderella story we've never seen before," ex-Tottenham boss Tim Sherwood, who gave Kane his full Premier League debut, tells Sky Sports . "He keeps breaking records, and I keep thinking: 'Are we talking about the same kid?' "There was always a chance, because he felt like there was no ceiling - he would always just break through and go further. "I mean, not even Harry would say he could believe it, I would suggest." Kane becomes first English winner of Ballon d'Or in 25 years The Bayern Munich striker has become the first English Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years and just the fifth in its history. The deal will see him remain with the Bundesliga giants until the summer of 2029. Sky in Germany are reporting Kane's new salary is at least £20.9m (€25m) gross per year. "I feel right at home at FC Bayern," Kane told the club's official website. "I love the club, the fans and the city of Munich. We have a fantastic team and, in Vincent Kompany, a fantastic manager. It makes me very proud to be part of this club.
